newsitem.title: CANADA: Degussa Quebec project on hold after deal.
newsitem.headline: Degussa Quebec project on hold after deal.

text.p: Plans by Degussa AG to build a hydrogen peroxide plant in Quebec City starting at the end of August are on hold after the German company's announcement on Thursday it would buy DuPont Co's peroxide plants in North America.
"All of Degussa's projects are on hold pending due diligence on DuPont's plants," Degussa spokesman Regis Labaume told Reuters.
Any construction would be delayed at least three months, Labaume said.
The C$140 million Quebec plant was to produce 65,000 tonnes of hydrogen peroxide, a bleaching agent, for North America's paper mills. It was to employ 60 people.
If its deal with DuPont goes through, Degussa will acquire facilities including a plant in Memphis, Tenn. and two others in Alberta and Ontario owned by affiliate DuPont Canada Inc .
